coordinate_notes: Pixel coordinates [x, y] in the saved file (origin top-left). nose_tip/tail_tip are the board's extreme points; tail_tip null means it is outside the frame. width_at_middle_px is the board width measured across the board (perpendicular to its long axis) around middle_point. Estimated from a 100 px grid, accuracy roughly +/- 15 px.
